title: Practice 3: Since, till, by, before, after

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Комендантский час начинается с 10 ___ (вечер).
exercises.why: «С + Gen. meaning "from" or "since".» — DLI, Lesson 76.

exercises.q: Она, точно, умела молчать до ___ (последняя минута).
exercises.why: «ДО + Gen. meaning "till" (indicating a time limit of an action).» — DLI, Lesson 76.

exercises.q: Хотите ветчины к ___ (завтрак)?
exercises.prompt: Would you like some ham for breakfast?
exercises.why: «The preposition К + Dat. denotes the time by which an event takes place.» — DLI, Lesson 77.

exercises.q: Они явились почти через месяц после ___ (тревожная ночь).
exercises.why: «"Перед" means immediately before, whereas "до" can cover a longer space of time before.» После + genitive: after. — DLI, Lessons 27, 43.

exercises.q: Перед ___ (полдень) все трое садятся на берегу реки.
exercises.why: «"Перед" means immediately before, whereas "до" can cover a longer space of time before.» После + genitive: after. — DLI, Lessons 27, 43.

exercises.q: Жизнь мальчика около ___ (неделя) висела на волоске.
exercises.why: «Prepositions in time expressions»: в, на, по, с, до, за, к, через, назад. — DLI, Lessons 73–77.

exercises.q: It has been raining on and off since the day before yesterday.
exercises.ru: С ___ то шёл, то переставал дождь.
exercises.why: «С + Gen. meaning "from" or "since".» — DLI, Lesson 76.
